major.summary: The plan cannot truthfully produce both page-level scalar totals and top-query rows through the existing GSC request boundary.
major.evidence: The existing builder converts omitted or empty dimensions to [query]. A bounded query request cannot also establish page totals when further queries exist.
major.impact: A partial top-query aggregate could be mislabeled as total page performance.
major.recommendation: Add a backward-compatible ungrouped aggregate request, keep top queries separate, and never derive totals from the query list.

major.summary: The required 28-day Pacific final-data window needs an explicit implementation contract.
major.evidence: The upstream convenience range uses UTC and subtracts 28 from an inclusive end, yielding 29 dates.
major.impact: The tool could fetch the wrong period across Pacific midnight or DST while claiming 28 days.
major.recommendation: Require a pure injected Pacific window helper and explicit start/end dates.

major.summary: The GSC DTO needs explicit empty, malformed and partial-failure semantics.
major.evidence: No reported aggregate and an observed zero aggregate are different, and two separate requests can fail independently.
major.impact: An implementation could invent zero facts, leak provider metadata, or present mixed results as coherent.
major.recommendation: Define a strict live-GSC union and make either subrequest failure suppress the whole live section.

major.evidence: The current helper groups only by max checkedAt and cannot uniquely resolve same-time rows or runs completed after asOf.
major.impact: An older matching URL could be shown after the keyword moved away.
major.recommendation: Specify all eligibility predicates and deterministic completedAt/checkedAt/snapshot-ID partition order before URL filtering.

major.summary: The three URL identities need a normative table and exact construction rules.
major.evidence: Key-page, workflow, browser-standard URL and rank-variant normalization intentionally differ.
major.impact: Matching could broaden silently or sensitive query material could enter output.
major.recommendation: Define transport/display separation and enumerate rank variants.

do_not_change: Preserve the existing MCP server, canonical project auth, SAM injection, GSC credential service and D1/Postgres abstraction.
Preserve the distinction between exact key-page curation, canonical workflow links and rank-result variants.
